Anonymous usage metrics: OFF

What we collect: the name of each bd command you run, plus the bd version
and OS platform, keyed by a machine-derived, HMAC-protected ID. We never
collect your issues, paths, remotes, identity, or any text you type. Seeing
real usage patterns is how we decide what to improve next — thank you for
helping make bd better.

Where it goes: https://gastownhall-eventsapi.com/mp/collect

  See real examples:  bd metrics example
  Turn on:            bd metrics on

Note: BD_DISABLE_METRICS=1 is overriding your saved config (which is "on") for this shell.
